entries.26af5cd9e885d4ee: For the fiscal year ended December 2025, net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥771 million. In the previous fiscal year, net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥639 million.
entries.2da5685600f6bcb0: Its main customers are businesses in cosmetics and beauty, food and health foods, daily goods and general merchandise, and chemicals and pharmaceuticals, and it sells to 4,313 companies worldwide from sales bases in Japan, China, the United States, Thailand, the Netherlands and India. entries.667d10d0306a2d8a: This business combines container bodies made with in-house owned molds with caps and other accessories, and provides packaging containers tailored to each customer's design through coloring and printing, with short lead times and small lot sizes.
entries.6ce7b0e83dd03c6a: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥14,491 million, down 7.3% from the previous year. Japan recorded lower revenue due to declines in spot projects and large repeat projects, while China and India recorded higher revenue. Revenue from external customers by region was ¥10,909 million in Japan, ¥2,200 million in China and ¥1,381 million in other regions.

entries.720cded59049a8de: It sells to 4,313 companies worldwide from sales bases in Japan, China, the United States, Thailand, the Netherlands and India. Revenue in India reached its highest level since market entry, and in China, new project wins are progressing through a review of sales operations, including development in the food sector.
entries.7d1b2e93191f623a: Net income attributable to owners of the parent of ¥771 million
entries.848e913c5e3bc75f: It aims to become a 'resource-circulating packaging company' and is pursuing 'strengthening domestic business' and 'accelerating overseas business expansion.' As specific measures, it is addressing as important issues the strengthening of development and proposal capabilities, achieving overwhelming speed, and strengthening and establishing WEB marketing. It is also promoting development of new environmentally friendly products, such as containers using biodegradable resins, biomass raw materials and recycled raw materials.
entries.9a986374da419e32: A single-segment business that manufactures and sells packaging containers and other products, conducted by the company and 7 consolidated subsidiaries (Kyoei Plasco Co., Ltd. and 6 overseas subsidiaries in China, the United States, the Netherlands, Thailand and India). The company collectively calls container bodies produced with molds it makes and owns, together with accessories such as caps and dispensers, 'standard bottles,' and by combining these and adding color or printing, offers packaging containers in designs tailored to each customer's requirements, with short lead times and in small lots. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥10,909 million in Japan, ¥2,200 million in China and ¥1,381 million in other regions.
